---
name: Experimental-design review
about: Pre-register an analysis or review an experiment before results are read
labels: [experiment]
---

## Hypothesis and estimand
Primary outcome, direction and experimental unit.

## Population and partitions
Fit, validation, pilot, test/holdout; leakage checks.

## Treatments and controls
Treatment definition, fair control, realized dose, no-op policy.

## Pre-registered analysis
Primary family, secondary analyses, uncertainty method, correction, chosen sample/draw counts.

## Implementation validation
Baseline reproduction; prompt/model/data hashes; cached/reference parity; dry run.

## Provenance
Run ID, git SHA, resolved config, model and input hashes.

## Results
Full table, exact numerator/denominator, failures, intervals, corrected p-values.

## Interpretation
Supported claim, alternate explanations, limitations, replication status.

## Deviations
Any changes after results inspection, reasons and exploratory labeling.
